text_block_list.text:
Shortly after the Takarazuka Kinen, the 
"Summer Training Camp" arrived. Air Groove 
appears normal at first glance, but...

She was so disheartened that she couldn't 
completely hide it, occasionally showing a 
gloomy expression.

Wanting to support Air Groove, the Trainer 
is advised by Symboli Rudolf, who noticed 
something amiss, to give her firm and 
steadfast support.

Given a push of encouragement, the Trainer 
takes action to help Air Groove regain her 
confidence in the Sapporo Kinen and guide 
her toward a full resurgence.
